features: Automatic email when fieldwork is assigned
The assigned user now receives an email with the activity title, dates, location and details as soon as an activity is created for them or reassigned to them
Staff in the field know about new work right away, even if they never open the system
Email when a schedule changes
When the dates of an activity change, the assigned user is emailed the new dates
No one shows up on the wrong day
Reminder emails before fieldwork
The assigned user is emailed the morning before the activity starts and again on the morning it starts
Fieldwork is not forgotten, with no need to check the calendar
Overdue follow-up emails

If an activity is still not marked Completed or Missed after its last day, the assigned user is emailed 1, 3 and 7 days later asking them to confirm what happened or reschedule; from the third day the person who created the activity is copied
Unclosed activities no longer sit unnoticed, and the Missed and Completed records stay accurate
Email when fieldwork is marked as missed
When an activity is marked Missed, both the assigned user and the person who created it are told
Supervisors know right away when planned fieldwork did not happen
Runs without anyone logged in
A scheduled task on the server checks the schedule every 10 minutes, sends the emails that are due and keeps activity statuses up to date
The system keeps working on people's behalf while they are out in the field
No duplicate or outdated emails

Each alert is sent only once, a failed email is retried later, and an email is dropped if the activity was completed, deleted, reassigned or rescheduled before it was sent. People are not emailed about their own changes
Fewer, more useful emails
Email note on the activity form
The Add / Edit Activity form now tells the user that the assigned person will be emailed
Users know what happens when they save
